what: Reveal ggplot2 Layers Step by Step in PowerPoint and Beamer Slides
title: Reveal ggplot2 Layers Step by Step in PowerPoint and Beamer Slides
text: Reveal layers saved ggplot step step, PowerPoint LaTeX beamer. dependencies (ggplot2, officer, rvg, xml2) installed automatically. following code creates PowerPoint presentation working directory animates layers (e.g., geoms) ggplot2 object (p). Positive numbers animate mark layer step animates (step runs next number); negative numbers animate step started layer. Except plot file name, arguments can left blank, using defaults: every layer plot appears click, axes, titles legend shown start. animate lists layers new step starts. Everything first number shown start, last number also brings everything . plot , animate = c(3, 4, 5) gives: animate = NULL (default) reveals every layer . Removing step : negative number makes step started layer disappear, e.g., animate = c(3, 4, 5, -3) shows 3, 4, 5+ removes layer 3 . PowerPoint effect entry used exit animation ("fade" fades , "wipe_left" wipes away); beamer layer simply gone next overlay. effect, trigger duration count removals steps .
code: # install.packages("remotes") remotes::install_github("joellattmann/gganimslide") ggppt(p, "savings.pptx",       animate  = c(1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 8, -8),       effect   = c("wipe_up", "wipe_left", "fade", "wipe_left", "fade", "fade", "fade"),       trigger  = c("click", "click", "after", "click", "after", "click", "click"),       duration = c(1, 2.5, 0.5, 2.5, 0.5, 0.6, 0.6)) library(gganimslide); library(ggplot2)  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x, y)) +   geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +                       # 1   geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +                       # 2   geom_point(aes(colour = g)) +                      # 3   geom_smooth(method = "lm") +                       # 4   annotate("text", 2, -1.5, label = "beta = 0.6") +  # 5   geom_rug()                                         # 6  ggppt(p, "plot.pptx", animate = c(3, 4, 5), title = "My plot") # powerpoint  ggtex(p, "fig/plot.pdf", animate = c(3, 4, 5), title = "My plot", tex = "plot_frame.tex") # latex beamer

title: Reveal ggplot2 Layers Step by Step in PowerPoint and Beamer Slides
text: default (scope = "layers") numbers count geoms, stats annotate(); axes, titles, legend theme always shown. Two options let reveal + component: finished ggplot forgets order components added, "" "all_but_theme" package needs order. Either wrap plot code steps() make plot (order stored object survives saveRDS() / readRDS()): write plot code directly call: default scope = "layers" (categorical = TRUE) none needed: saved ggplot works . modes step full redraw (titles themes can change layout), PowerPoint every step covers previous one; set bg slide background isn’t white.
code: p <- steps(   ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) +     geom_point() +                    # 1     labs(title = "Fuel use") +        # 2     theme_minimal() +                 # 3     geom_smooth(method = "lm")        # 4 )  plot_components(p) # shows the numbering for each scope  ggppt(p, "fuel.pptx", animate = c(2, 3, 4), scope = "all") ggppt(ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) + geom_point() + labs(title = "Fuel use"),       "fuel.pptx", animate = 2, scope = "all")

title: Reveal ggplot2 Layers Step by Step in PowerPoint and Beamer Slides
text: plot becomes stack editable vector shapes position: one base shape (axes, grid, legend, titles, static layers) plus one transparent shape per step. Native PowerPoint animations written slide, nothing set hand. shapes named Selection Pane (e.g., step 2: layer 4 geom_smooth), can still change effects PowerPoint’s Animation Pane. effect: "appear" (default), "fade", "wipe_left", "wipe_right", "wipe_up", "wipe_down". Give one value, one per step. size: "16:9" (default) "4:3" new decks; template keeps size. width, height, left, top: size position plot inches (default: area title; plot centred unless left/top given). Set size , dragging PowerPoint: dragging doesn’t scale text, resizing single step’s shape misaligns others. trigger: "click" (default), "", "". Give one value, one per step. Build deck several plots:
code: doc <- ppt_deck() # 16:9; or ppt_deck(template = "my_template.pptx") doc <- ggppt(p1, doc = doc, animate = c(3, 4), title = "First") doc <- ggppt(p2, doc = doc, effect = "fade", title = "Second") print(doc, target = "talk.pptx")

title: Reveal ggplot2 Layers Step by Step in PowerPoint and Beamer Slides
text: Writes multi-page PDF: page 1 = static part, page k+1 = static part + first k steps. pages cut one rendered plot, nothing shifts overlays. Prints (tex = writes) frame code: Use deck \input{plot_frame.tex}. standalone = TRUE gives complete compilable document instead. Set width/height (inches) size plot slide font sizes match. default 5.5 × 3 fits 16:9 beamer frame.

title: Animated PowerPoint slide from a ggplot — ggppt
text: p saved ggplot object. file Path `.pptx` write. `doc` given `file` `NULL`, nothing written updated `doc` returned. animate Layers new step starts. Layers first entry always shown; last entry also reveals later layers. `animate = c(3, 4, 5)` shows layers 1-2, adds 3, 4, 5 everything . `NULL` (default) reveals every layer . negative number removes step : `-3` makes step started layer 3 disappear (given `effect` exit animation PowerPoint), e.g. `animate = c(3, 4, 5, -3)`. Entries play order given, `effect`, `trigger` `duration` count removals steps. scope numbers `animate` count: `"layers"` (default), `""` `"all_but_theme"`. See [ggtex()] details. `""` `"all_but_theme"` step full redraw plot (`bg` background) covers previous one, components titles themes change layout. title Slide title. `NULL` title. effect Entrance effect: `"appear"`, `"fade"`, `"wipe_left"`, `"wipe_right"`, `"wipe_up"` `"wipe_down"`. One value, one per step. trigger `"click"` (default), `""` (previous step) `""` (previous step). One value, one per step. duration Effect duration seconds (ignored `"appear"`). doc Optional existing `rpptx` object ([officer::read_pptx()]) add slide . Lets build whole deck several plots. template Optional `.pptx` template whose theme slide size used new deck. size Slide size new deck `template` given: `"16:9"` (default) `"4:3"`. Ignored `doc` `template` given. width, height Size plot slide inches. Default: free area title. Set size rather dragging PowerPoint: dragging scales lines points text, resizing one step's shape misaligns others. full 16:9 slide 13.33 x 7.5 inches. left, top Position plot's top-left corner inches. Default: centred free area title. location Optional officer location plot (overrides `width`, `height`, `left`, `top`), e.g. `officer::ph_location(left = 1, top = 1.5, width = 8, height = 5)`. Defaults area title. editable `TRUE`, shapes text plot can edited PowerPoint. bg Background full redraws used `""` `"all_but_theme"`. match slide background. categorical `TRUE`, every group within step (bar, box, colour group, line `colour =` mapping, ...) revealed , group order. step's `effect`, `trigger` `duration` apply group, negative number removes groups step . `scope = "layers"`. ... arguments [rvg::dml()], e.g. `fonts`.

what: Animated beamer slide from a ggplot — ggtex
title: Animated beamer slide from a ggplot — ggtex
text: Writes multi-page PDF page 1 shows static layers (axes, legend, titles) page *k + 1* adds first *k* animation steps, returns beamer code shows one page per overlay (beamer's `\` command). Every page cut rendered plot, nothing moves steps.

title: Animated beamer slide from a ggplot — ggtex
code: ggtex(   p,   file,   animate = NULL,   scope = c("layers", "all", "all_but_theme"),   width = 5.5,   height = 3,   title = NULL,   tex = NULL,   standalone = FALSE,   graphics_path = NULL,   include_width = "\\linewidth",   start = 1,   device = NULL,   categorical = FALSE,   verbose = TRUE )

title: Animated beamer slide from a ggplot — ggtex
text: p saved ggplot object. file Path PDF write (e.g. `"figures/turnout.pdf"`). Required. animate Layers new step starts. Layers first entry always shown; last entry also reveals later layers. `animate = c(3, 4, 5)` shows layers 1-2, adds 3, 4, 5 everything . `NULL` (default) reveals every layer . negative number removes step : `-3` makes step started layer 3 disappear (given `effect` exit animation PowerPoint), e.g. `animate = c(3, 4, 5, -3)`. Entries play order given, `effect`, `trigger` `duration` count removals steps. scope numbers `animate` count. `"layers"` (default): geoms, stats annotations; axes, titles, legend theme always shown. `""`: every `+` component plot order written (geoms, `labs()`, scales, coords, facets, `theme_*()`, `theme()`). `"all_but_theme"`: like `""`, `theme()` `theme_*()` calls counted always applied. two, plot must made [steps()], code written directly call. width, height Size PDF inches. Use size plot slide text sizes match (full 16:9 beamer frame 5.5 x 3). title Frame title. `NULL` title. tex Optional path `.tex` file write code . standalone `TRUE`, code complete, compilable beamer document instead single frame. graphics_path `file` referred LaTeX code. Defaults `file`, path relative `tex` `tex` given. include_width Width passed `\includegraphics`. start First overlay number, frame overlays plot. device PDF device; `grDevices::cairo_pdf` (available) handles Unicode system fonts, `grDevices::pdf` fallback. categorical `TRUE`, every group within step (bar, box, colour group, ...) gets overlay, group order. See [ggppt()]. verbose `TRUE` (default), LaTeX code printed console.

title: Animated beamer slide from a ggplot — ggtex
text: LaTeX code (invisibly); also printed `verbose = TRUE`.

title: Animated beamer slide from a ggplot — ggtex
code: library(ggplot2) p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) +   geom_point(colour = "grey70") +   geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x) +   geom_point(data = subset(mtcars, mpg > 30), colour = "red") out <- tempfile(fileext = ".pdf") ggtex(p, out, animate = c(2, 3), title = "Fuel use") #> \begin{frame}{Fuel use} #>   \centering #>   % gganimslide: static 1 | 2 geom_smooth | 3 geom_point #>   \only<1>{\includegraphics[width=\linewidth,page=1]{/tmp/RtmpIRxLoG/file190b6ff0bdd0.pdf}}% #>   \only<2>{\includegraphics[width=\linewidth,page=2]{/tmp/RtmpIRxLoG/file190b6ff0bdd0.pdf}}% #>   \only<3->{\includegraphics[width=\linewidth,page=3]{/tmp/RtmpIRxLoG/file190b6ff0bdd0.pdf}}% #> \end{frame}

title: gganimslide 0.1.0 (beta)
text: First public release. ggppt(): animated PowerPoint slides one editable vector shape per step native entrance animations (appear, fade, wipe_*; click, previous step). ggtex(): animated beamer slides (multi-page PDF + \<> overlay code). animate = c(3, 4, 5): layers 3 static, last number also reveals everything . scope = "layers" / "" / "all_but_theme": reveal geoms, every + component (labs, scales, coords, facets, themes). Component order recorded automatically gganimslide loaded; steps() fallback; plot_components() shows numbering. 16:9 slides default; ppt_deck() decks several plots.
